title: On computing the spherical roots for a class of spherical subgroups
summary: Given a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, we consider the class of spherical subgroups $H \subset G$ such that $H$ is regularly embedded in a parabolic subgroup $P \subset G$ and $H,P$ have a common Levi subgroup $L$. In a previous paper, the author developed a fast algorithm that reduces the computation of the set of spherical roots for such subgroups $H$ to the case where the quotient of Lie algebras $\operatorname{Lie} P / \operatorname{Lie} H$ is a strictly indecomposable spherical $L$-module.
